metadata.description: Deterministic marine safety notices, weather alerts, and navigation restrictions
metadata.disclaimer: Authoritative marine safety notices calibrated for prototype safety-engine demonstration.

alerts.title: Squally Wind Warning for Afternoon Hours (Gusts > 22 kts)
alerts.areaDescription: Offshore Raigad and Ratnagiri beyond 15 nautical miles
alerts.advisoryAction: Motorized crafts < 10m advised to conclude operations before 13:00 IST

alerts.title: Submerged Shoal / Shallow Sandbar Alert (Prongs Reef & Dharamtal)
alerts.areaDescription: Dharamtal Creek Entrance Shoal Bank & South Colaba Reef
alerts.advisoryAction: Maintain minimum 1.5 nm clearance from marked shoal during ebb tide (< 1.5m chart datum)

alerts.title: Naval Anchorage & Defense Exclusion Buffer (Geofence Clearance: 4.2 km)
alerts.areaDescription: Western Naval Command Outer Anchorage Corridor (18.85°N, 72.78°E)
alerts.advisoryAction: Maintain mandatory 1000m security buffer. Corridor currently verified clear with 4.2 km buffer.

alerts.title: Southwest Monsoon Swell Surge (Peak Hs 2.1m — 2.4m)
alerts.areaDescription: Continental shelf transition zone 12–25 km offshore Alibaug
alerts.advisoryAction: Midday return swell exceeds 1.8m wave limit for traditional motorized crafts. Plan early transit.

alerts.title: Submarine Telecom Fiber Cable & Pipeline Corridor Survey
alerts.areaDescription: Versova to Mumbai High South Subsea Cable Route
alerts.advisoryAction: Bottom trawling prohibited within 500m of cable waypoints. Surface transit permitted.
